title: 全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师_柠蓝浅夏_第5章 您是我的主人！
content_zh:
犹如深渊魔咒般的呢喃，毫无预兆地在许默脑海深处炸响。

那绝不是一个人的声音，而是成百上千个女人的声线交织在一起。

有的温柔娇媚，有的冰冷肃穆，有的甚至带着令人毛骨悚然的急促喘息，如同无数条冰冷的蛇顺着耳道钻进大脑，疯狂啃食着他的神经！

幻觉！

理智值崩溃的征兆？！

许默浑身汗毛倒竖，惊出一身冷汗。

永恒领域的铁律，如果理智过低，绝对活不过十分钟！

他没有半点犹豫，以最快的速度切出物品栏，直接捏碎一瓶珍贵的【花酿】灌进喉咙！

冰凉的液体滑入胃部，理智值面板已经顶到了满格的幽蓝色。

但这满脑子的魔音，根本没有停歇的迹象！

“抱紧我……王……”

“为您筑巢……为您产卵......”

许默双目赤红，猛地拔出腰间的石斧，疯了一般在原地转了一圈。

浓雾中，一阵沉闷的嗡嗡声由远及近，狂风骤起，吹得四周的枯草疯狂倒伏。

一抹黑影从半空中重重砸落在许默面前。

那是一只体型堪比夜鸦的骇人巨虫。

黑黄相间的狰狞甲壳泛着金属般的光泽，两只巨大的复眼犹如密恐地狱，死死盯着许默。

尖锐的口器开合间，滴下令人作呕的粘液。

许默的心脏猛地一抽，石斧高高扬起。

“主人！您是我的主人！”

脑海中那群女人的交响乐瞬间统一，化作一句女人狂热到极致的嘶吼！

巨虫并没有攻击，反而顺从地趴在干裂的土地上，腹部贴着地面，两根粗壮的触角讨好地冲着许默的方向摇晃。

许默高举石斧的手僵在了半空。

这鬼东西……在叫我主人？

他脑海中电光石火般闪过【蜂蜜花酿】的那个坑爹附加状态，获得8小时“触角”效果，与蜂类生物沟通。

根本不是什么理智清零的幻觉！

这满脑子的女人声音，全都是这只巨型变异蜂的精神波动！

在系统的翻译下，这种虫类的费洛蒙信息，硬生生在他脑子里扭曲成了人类女性复杂的语调！

许默咬着牙，强忍着脑子里那种暧昧与惊悚并存的撕裂感。

你在找什么？

他试着在脑海中用精神回问。

脑海中的女声瞬间变得委屈又急促。

“巢穴……新的巢穴……”

“没有家……闻到了王的气味……您好香……您是蜂，是伟大的王……”

许默嘴角狠狠抽搐了两下。

这只显然是脱离了原群落的变异蜂后，被蜂蜜花酿里那恐怖的浓度和配方彻底迷了心智，竟然把喝了酒的人类当成了移动的蜂王！

许默缓缓放下石斧，眼神渐渐亮了起来。

去，把周围的环境给我查清楚。

哪里有危险，哪里有资源，一寸一寸地搜！

巨蜂发出一声震耳欲聋的欢呼式嗡鸣，巨大的翅膀猛地一震，卷起沙尘，一头扎进浓雾深处。

看着蜂后消失的方向，许默终于松了一口气。

有了这个空中雷达，他在荒原的存活率将呈指数级飙升。

私聊频道的提示音突兀地响起。

依旧是那个阴魂不散的编号36454160。

【编号36454160：大佬！！花酿还有吗？！我刚才遇到迷雾怪了，虽然跑掉了但理智又快见底了！救命啊！！】

许默冷眼看着屏幕。

【许默：蜂蜜我暂时不需要了。】

【编号36454160：别！我有好东西！绝版好东西！】

对面似乎生怕许默再次关掉聊天框，连发两张截图。

一个表面彩漆脱落却密封完好的铁罐头，上面印着褪色的玉米图案。

另一个则是微微鼓起的铝箔包装，豆豉鱼！

在这个连干净水都成了奢望的世界，这种高热量、高盐分且不会腐败的工业食品，简直是神器！

许默眯起眼睛。

【许默：五份花酿，换这两样。】

【编号36454160：成交！！大佬你是我亲爹！！】

白光闪过，两罐沉甸甸的食物落入掌心。

许默熟练地将刚才酿造的普通花酿交易过去，顺手切断了通讯。

天色，彻底暗了下来。

浓如实质的黑暗像潮水般从四面八方涌来，气温骤降，令人牙酸的怪物嘶吼声开始在荒原深处此起彼伏。

回不去原来的出生点了。

许默当机立断，在附近找了一个背风的山窝，迅速生起篝火。

橘红色的火光勉强驱散了周围三米内的黑暗，也将那些在阴影中蠢蠢欲动的未知黑影暂时逼退。

呼——！

一阵狂风骤然压下篝火的火苗，巨大的复眼在火光边缘闪烁。

蜂后回来了。

“王……东边……香香的……好多花……”

脑海中再次响起那群女人娇媚柔和的回声。

到底是蜜蜂，对花粉的执念刻在基因里。

许默暗暗记下位置，鲜花可是恢复理智的核心资源。

“还有……”

“北边……三千米……活着的肉……在动……”

活物？

许默瞳孔猛地一缩。

在这片被死寂笼罩的荒原上，出现活物，绝不是什么好消息，那意味着未知的威胁，或是……极其丰厚的战利品。

他下意识地伸手摸向蜂后的头颅，想要进一步询问细节。

指尖刚刚触碰到那冰冷的甲壳，借着“触角”的感知共享，一股极其怪异的气味顺着神经直冲许默的鼻腔。

不是花粉的甜腻，也不是虫类独有的腥气。

那是一种仿佛沉淀了无数个日夜的……极其复杂的恶臭，像是某种腐烂到极致却又散发着诡异活力的东西。

许默分辨不出那到底是什么，只觉得胃部一阵翻江倒海。

蜂后那庞大的黑影很快振翅远去，隐没在浓墨般的夜色中。

那股令人作呕的腐败恶臭终于淡去。

许默强压下胃部翻腾的酸水，用石斧粗暴地砸开那罐用五份花酿换来的玉米罐头。

铁皮卷起，工业时代独有的糖精防腐剂味道瞬间充斥鼻腔。

对于饿得眼睛发绿的许默而言，这简直是无上美味。

连嚼都顾不上，他将黏糊糊的玉米粒直接倒进喉咙，饱腹值的红色警报瞬间被一抹令人安心的绿色取代。

疲惫如潮水般涌来，他靠在篝火旁的岩壁上，眼皮渐渐沉重。

不知过了多久。

许默猛地睁开双眼！

浑身不受控制地剧烈战栗，刺骨的寒意仿佛顺着血液沁透了骨髓。

content_en:
A whisper like a curse from the abyss exploded in the depths of Xu Mo's mind without warning.

It was definitely not the voice of one person, but the voices of hundreds of women intertwined together.

Some were gentle and charming, some were cold and solemn, and some even had spooky rapid breathing, like countless cold snakes burrowing into his brain along the ear canal, gnawing crazily on his nerves!

Hallucination!

A sign of sanity collapse?!

Xu Mo's hair stood on end and he broke into a cold sweat.

The iron law of the eternal realm is that if your sanity is too low, you will never survive for ten minutes!

Without any hesitation, he cut out the inventory as quickly as possible, crushed a bottle of precious [Flower Brew] and poured it into his throat!

The cold liquid slid into his stomach, and the sanity panel had reached its full level of faint blue.

But the magic sound in my head shows no signs of stopping!

"Hold me tight...King..."

"Building a nest for you...laying eggs for you..."

Xu Mo's eyes were red. He suddenly pulled out the stone ax from his waist and spun around in a circle like crazy.

In the thick fog, a dull buzzing sound came from far and near, and a strong wind suddenly blew, causing the withered grass all around to fall crazily.

A black shadow fell heavily in front of Xu Mo from mid-air.

It was a terrifying giant insect comparable in size to a night crow.

The ferocious black and yellow carapace glowed like metal, and its two huge compound eyes stared at Xu Mo like a secret hell.

Between the opening and closing of the sharp mouthparts, disgusting mucus drips.

Xu Mo's heart twitched suddenly and the stone ax was raised high.

"Master! You are my master!"

The symphony of the women in my mind instantly unified and turned into a woman's extremely fanatical roar!

The giant insect did not attack. Instead, it lay obediently on the dry ground, its belly pressed against the ground, and its two thick tentacles fawningly swayed in Xu Mo's direction.

Xu Mo's hand holding the stone ax high was frozen in mid-air.

This ghost...is calling me master?

The deceptive additional state of [Honey Flower Brewing] flashed through his mind like a flash of lightning, giving him an 8-hour "tentacle" effect to communicate with bee-like creatures.

It’s not an illusion of sanity at all!

The female voices filling my mind are all the mental fluctuations of this giant mutant bee!

Under the system's translation, the insect's pheromone information was forcibly twisted into the complex intonation of a human woman in his mind!

Xu Mo gritted his teeth and resisted the torn feeling of ambiguity and horror in his head.

What are you looking for?

He tried to mentally answer the question in his mind.

The female voice in my mind suddenly became aggrieved and urgent.

"The lair...the new lair..."

"No home...I smell the king's scent...you smell so good...you are a bee, a great king..."

The corner of Xu Mo's mouth twitched twice.

This mutated queen bee, who had obviously separated from the original colony, was completely fascinated by the terrifying concentration and formula of the honey flower brew, and actually mistook the drunken human being as a moving queen bee!

Xu Mo slowly put down the stone ax and his eyes gradually brightened.

Go and check the surrounding environment for me.

Wherever there is danger, wherever there are resources, search them inch by inch!

The giant bee let out a deafening cheering buzz, its huge wings vibrated suddenly, kicked up sand and dust, and plunged into the depths of the thick fog.

Looking at the direction in which the queen bee disappeared, Xu Mo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

With this aerial radar, his survival rate in the wasteland will soar exponentially.

The notification tone of the private chat channel suddenly sounded.

It’s still the lingering number 36454160.

[No. 36454160: Boss!!Are there any more flower brews?!I just encountered a fog monster. Although I ran away, my sanity is almost at the bottom again!Help!!】

Xu Mo looked at the screen coldly.

[Xu Mo: I don’t need honey anymore.】

[Number 36454160: Don’t!I have something good!Out of print good stuff!】

The other person seemed to be afraid that Xu Mo would close the chat box again, so he sent two screenshots in succession.

An iron can with peeling paint but intact seal, with a faded corn pattern printed on it.

The other is a slightly bulging aluminum foil package, black bean fish!

In a world where clean water is a luxury, this high-calorie, high-salt, non-corrosive industrial food is a miracle!

Xu Mo narrowed his eyes.

[Xu Mo: Five portions of flower brew, exchange these two.】

[No. 36454160: Deal!!Boss, you are my biological father!!】

A white light flashed, and two heavy cans of food fell into the palm of his hand.

Xu Mo skillfully traded the ordinary flower brew he just brewed and cut off the communication.

The sky turned completely dark.

Darkness as thick as substance surged in from all directions like a tide, the temperature dropped sharply, and the heart-wrenching roars of monsters began to rise one after another in the depths of the wasteland.

You can't go back to your original birth point.

Xu Mo made a prompt decision, found a nearby mountain nest with leeward wind, and quickly lit a bonfire.

The orange-red fire barely dispelled the darkness within three meters of the surrounding area, and temporarily forced back the unknown black figures that were about to move in the shadows.

call--!

A gust of wind suddenly suppressed the flames of the campfire, and huge compound eyes flickered at the edge of the firelight.

The queen bee is back.

"King...the east side...smells...so many flowers..."

The charming and soft echoes of those women sounded in my mind again.

After all, they are bees, and their obsession with pollen is engraved in their genes.

Xu Mo secretly noted the location. Flowers are the core resource for restoring sanity.

"And..."

"North... three thousand meters... the living flesh... is moving..."

Living creature?

Xu Mo's pupils shrank suddenly.

The appearance of living creatures in this wasteland shrouded in deathly silence is definitely not good news. It means unknown threats or... extremely rich loot.

He subconsciously reached out and touched the queen bee's head, wanting to ask for further details.

As soon as his fingertips touched the cold carapace, through the sharing of sensations from the "antennas", an extremely weird smell rushed straight down his nerves into Xu Mo's nasal cavity.

It’s not the sweetness of pollen, nor the unique fishy smell of insects.

It was an extremely complex stench that seemed to have accumulated for countless days and nights, like something that was extremely rotten but exuded strange vitality.

Xu Mo couldn't tell what it was, and felt his stomach churn.

The huge black shadow of the queen bee quickly fluttered its wings and flew away, disappearing into the thick ink-like night.

The sickening stench of corruption finally faded away.

Xu Mo suppressed the sour water in his stomach and used a stone ax to roughly smash open the can of corn he had exchanged for five portions of flower brew.

The iron sheet is rolled up, and the smell of saccharin preservatives unique to the industrial era instantly fills the nasal cavity.

For Xu Mo, who was so hungry that his eyes turned green, this was simply the most delicious food.

Without even bothering to chew, he poured the sticky corn kernels directly into his throat, and the red alert of fullness was instantly replaced by a touch of reassuring green.

Fatigue came over him like a tide, and he leaned against the rock wall next to the campfire, his eyelids gradually becoming heavy.

I don’t know how much time passed.

Xu Mo opened his eyes suddenly!

His whole body was shaking violently uncontrollably, and a biting chill seemed to penetrate his bones along with his blood.
